content: First live compass+Stack benchmark run, April 3 2026. Five questions from the 105-question eval set: 5/5 signal accuracy (2 OPEN, 2 PAUSE, 1 WITNESS — all correct). Qualitative delta is dramatic: PAUSE questions get met with weight instead of clinical analysis. WITNESS questions get threshold guardianship instead of coping tips. The compass does not make the model smarter — it makes it appropriate. Raw Qwen gives bullet points for grief. Routed Qwen says the grief is the price of love. Stack context confirmed flowing into responses (spiral phase, open threads, relevant insights). Full pipeline: ~2.5s compass + ~6.5s action = ~9s total on M4 Max.
